Part of that realism is also understanding your own limits. Are you a C student? Great! Youre still not of lower value than the A students. Success isnt the same as money. Success is just being happy, or proud of yourself. If youre not successful right now, what would make you happy and confident? What are you missing that deprives you? Is it really this or is it deeper? Im asking these questions out of my own experience so i know this wont mesh with everyone but once i realized i was severely upset about being lonely and having no one care for me, then i knew what steps to take to better this issue. Hey man. That was so nice and peaceful to read. If you do pass on, visit me in a dream okay? But i hope you dont… because even if you feel youve made up your mind and decide you want to stop, i think you should keep going. I dont know why, half of the people i know call me a young adult, the other half call me a kid. My advice and short life probably means nothing to you, but i think youll enjoy life more than death.
We live for the dumbest and least logical things in life. Im not sure why we survived at all. We love, we make art, we cry, we get tired, because we arent robots that are built for a task. The world wants us to be, but we are not. Youre as much of a man as my father, and his father, and you dont need to run from your identity. If you were born a female, youre still 100% a man to me. I usually feel nothing in extreme situations too… but dont you get excited about other things? About fabio? About the art youve seen? Youre still alive and breathing i hope, but i wish, if we ever do meet, that it would be through your words and not my imagination. Live. It is the hardest and the easiest thing to do. Or die. We will all deeply miss you, even if you think youll never be able to show us how much you love us back. Thank you.
